# Hibiscus 0.8.35

This update gives the editor and Note Assistant a quieter, more consistent
interface, with more room to write and quicker keyboard interactions.

- The top toolbar uses compact, consistently sized icons. A thin separator
  replaces the editor's top fade, and the first line has more breathing room.
- The editor caret is slightly thicker and follows your interface accent or
  note theme. Its color stays correct as the editor updates without changing
  your text or selection.
- Note Assistant has a refreshed conversation layout and an integrated composer
  with Plus, model, and reasoning controls. Selected-text context is clearer,
  model search stays close to the input, and reply actions are more compact.
- Editor AI and assistant menus open with short, anchored transitions. Escape
  closes them immediately and restores typing focus; repeated opening and
  closing keeps the controls responsive.
- Formatting buttons have a gentler press response, and AI edit confirmations
  use shorter, quieter transitions. Reduce Motion remains respected.
- Keyboard panel shortcuts and Quick Capture show and hide immediately, without
  waiting for an animation before you can continue.

No note migration is required. This interface update does not claim to resolve
the separate large-library slowdown or intermittent resize-crash reports.
